title: Initiative Compass: prescriptive remediation queue for near-term SLI regressions
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem statement: When SLI trajectories dip, teams lack a single, prioritized list of prescriptive remediation actions tied to error-budget runway and ownership. Current practices rely on ad-hoc Slack threads and shallow triage dashboards, which increases mean-time-to-recovery for regressions that could have been prevented or mitigated via targeted initiative playbooks.

Goal: Build a cross-cycle "Initiative Compass" feature in the Console that automatically ranks active reliability initiatives against near-term SLI regressions and surfaces a prescriptive remediation queue (playbook steps, suggested rollbacks, and small-scoped quick fixes) with clear owner assignments and gating criteria. The queue should: 1) prioritize actions that recover SLI within the next error-budget runway; 2) estimate impact and rollback risk; and 3) provide links to runbooks, dashboards, PRs, and on-call contacts.

Why now: We observed a 22% longer median time to repair for regressions that crossed the 3-day error-budget runway in Q4; early prescriptive actions reduce firefighting and enable scoped rollouts. This work will tie error-budget state with initiative execution and reduce cross-team coordination friction for reliability incidents.

Scope: Console UI list + prioritization engine + small automation hooks (create Linear tasks, prefill rollback PR templates) for teams that opt-in. Non-goals: full incident automation, replacing SRE on-call decision-making, or adding new SLI instrumentation (we rely on existing telemetry).
acceptance_criteria: Console shows a prioritized queue of remediation actions when any monitored SLI drops below its configured runway threshold (configurable: 1, 3, 7 days)

Each queued item includes: short description, estimated SLI impact, estimated rollback risk (low/medium/high), suggested owner, links to a runbook, relevant dashboard panels, and associated PR/issue links
Queue items can be converted to Linear tickets via a one-click 'Create Task' action that pre-populates title, description, and suggested assignee
Engine ranks candidate remediations using: error-budget runway remaining, historical rollback efficacy (from past incidents), and initiative priority weight (from Initiative Hub metadata)
Automated smoke-check step (optional) that can run a preflight canary for low-risk remediations and surface early signals in the queue
Feature has telemetry: queue open rate, action conversion rate, time-to-task-creation, and post-action SLI delta captured for 30 days
Documentation and runbook draft published to Confluence and linked from the Console
Security review completed (no secrets/external execution in first phase) and opt-in toggles respected for Dedicated/Private customers
